title: Get Access to the Monthly App Brewery Newsletter
summary: Optional sign-up article for the instructor's monthly email newsletter (the L.A.B. Report). No course content or exercise.

concepts.heading: Key takeaways
points: The newsletter is a once-a-month personal email covering what the instructor has been learning, side projects, and conversations with people in the tech industry about tools and trends.
Each issue includes three recommended reads picked that month, on subjects like design, programming, productivity and startup growth.
A sample issue is linked so you can judge it before subscribing.
Signing up is entirely optional and uses a Udemy-student sign-up link in the article; only join if you actually want the emails.
